revision_summary: 1) Fix three timestamp errors flagged by the deterministic check: the 'Text me, and I'll send you here in, like, two minutes' customer quote is at 05:00 not 03:42; '8AM? Next Saturday works.' is at 10:41-10:43 not 07:16; 'Cool. Thank you, boss man.' is at 11:29 not 11:05. These are all wrong_ts (words exist elsewhere), so correct the ts fields in script_coverage rather than removing the entries. 2) Reconcile the bill-photo-confirmation thread with the 07:02 line 'My guy, you're a quick worker' -- this is transcript evidence that the customer likely sent the bill during the 06:04-07:02 water-break gap. Stage 3 currently treats the bill as unconfirmed/promised_later throughout (cherry_pick_moments[5], bill_document_audit, observed_outcome, handoff_brief) without ever surfacing this counter-evidence. Revise these sections to present both readings (likely-sent vs. unconfirmed) rather than defaulting to the more negative fragile-booking read, and soften the outcome_dispute confidence accordingly. 3) Add the 00:16 'I already talked to somebody from your trucking' line as a flagged recycled-lead/prior-touchpoint signal referencing context.lead_types_and_bill_collection_rules, since this materially affects how bill-collection effort should be read. 4) Consider adding the 08:40 area-code question as a protocol-compliant example (protocols.how_did_you_get_my_number / scam_anxiety_signal directive) rather than only logging it as a generic state change -- the rep's honest, specific answer is a positive coachable moment currently uncredited.
